title: Seravanna – Wellness Services
subtitle: Comprehensive wellness services framework
text: Seamless booking workflows, intelligent chatbot integration, and complete administrative controls. Fully integrated Stripe booking, multi-tenant admin control, Meta Ads integration, and a RAG-enabled HBOT chat bot using free LLM models.

title: Mahoraga-AHAB – Trading Bot
subtitle: Autonomous LLM-powered intraday trading bot
text: Named after the Jujutsu Kaisen mythical beast that adapts to every attack — the system learns from its own trade history and adjusts behaviour in real-time. MCP server exposing 40+ tools for trading, analysis, and risk management, with yFinance integration and automated signal/sentiment scoring. Monitors positions with dynamic TP/SL, trailing stops, and LLM re-analysis via Entry/Exit Optimizer, Portfolio Manager, and Trade Journal agents.

title: ZuZu Scaffold
subtitle: Production-ready full-stack application scaffold
text: Focused on security, maintainability, and scalable team workflows. Built with React/TypeScript and Node/Express. Production-grade auth (JWT, CSRF, rate limiting), AI-driven workflow automation hooks, and OpenRouter integration with free-tier model evaluation tools.

title: NBCUniversal: Real-Time Rights Management
subtitle: High-throughput distributed content protection
text: Live content fingerprinting and rights enforcement across partner social video platforms. Event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka, FFMPEG integration for live stream processing, and zero-downtime deployment on Kubernetes and Docker Swarm.

title: Netrix Global: Multi-Cloud Orchestration Portal
subtitle: Enterprise infrastructure dashboard
text: Automated infrastructure provisioning, ETL pipeline monitoring, and billing analytics. Seamless integration with managed VMSphere environments and cloud services, a Next.js frontend with complex state management, Python/Airflow billing ETL pipelines, and robust RBAC with Enterprise SSO.

title: Moxi Labs AI
subtitle: Branded microsite for an AI consultancy
text: Full-screen cinematic microsite built on ZuZu's multi-tenant site platform — custom domain, hostname-based routing, and an events system with capacity-limited registration.

title: ARK OS
subtitle: Operating architecture for AI
text: A conceptual operating layer for orchestrating AI agents and workflows — early-stage microsite exploring the product's core narrative and visual identity.
